matrix.noise_policy: Prospective diagnostic only after no core group passed 2%; first functionally valid attempt retained with original strict flags. Earlier failed trials excluded.

repeat.purpose: Longer reverse-order repeats of the small idle gap and large busy optimization; first complete functional samples retained regardless of noise, with original strict flags.

notes: 100% CPU is one core; all daemon/viewer threads, providers and harness excluded.
Waited-child CPU is kept separate and is not a synchronized subprocess-tree accounting.
Noise diagnostic samples retain functional checks and original strict flags; these observations do not establish confidence intervals.
Profiling runs are separate from CPU comparisons. Telemetry spans overlap and measure elapsed wall time, not additive CPU.
PSS/RSS snapshots are outside CPU windows; these are memory observations, not allocation or leak measurements.
CPU is measured separately by /proc across all process threads.
Wall spans include waits, nested work, and possible descheduling; do not sum them as CPU.
Byte counters refer to named boundaries and can count the same payload more than once.
Aggregate deltas count completed spans, including those started before a phase. Still-open spans are absent.
Worker cpuUsage is process-wide, and deliberately not summed here.

cpu_profiles.method: Each recorded sample counts once. startTime plus cumulative timeDeltas selects the phase.
limits: timeDeltas include idle waits; their sum is elapsed time, not sampled CPU time.
Shares describe sampled main-thread execution, not process CPU percentages or predicted savings.
Inclusive rows overlap. A recursive frame counts at most once per sample.
Native work may appear in an FFI wrapper's self samples; the wrapper's self share is not allocation attribution.
Compiler, GC and other auxiliary-thread CPU is not attributed by this main-thread profile.
Line and column numbers are one-based positions in the compiled bundle, not repository source.
Short phases and low sample counts provide diagnostic ranking, not precise cost estimates.
